name: Pinky's Plot Quest
source:
Pinky needs to get laid, she has friends, but her friends have needs of their own. Can she help them out and get them in bed, or will she be horny, lonely, and doing science experiments with Twilight forever?

[From [url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/pinkys-plot-quest]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
碧琪想找人上床。她有朋友，可朋友们也各有各的需求。她能帮朋友们解决问题，再把她们拐上床吗？还是说，她注定得孤孤单单、欲火难耐地和紫悦做一辈子科学实验？
